power.jaymospowers.arsenal.desc: Reach into other dimensions and pull out whatever weapon answers. Summoned weapons return to their dimension after a while.
item.jaymospowers.arsenal_dimensional_ke: Cut for a lock you already carry.
It will not turn for an unpractised hand.
tooltip.jaymospowers.arsenal.summoned: Summoned: returns to its dimension in %ss
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.nothing_to_: You aren't holding a summoned weapon
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.ultimate_no: There is nothing there to fall on
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_1: Something on the other side of the rift turns its head.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_2: The rift is colder than it was.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_3: They are learning the way through.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_end: The void was waiting for you.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.purge_start: Its death is pulling something out of you.
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.starter: Rummage: reach in and see what turns up
item.jaymospowers.arsenal_relic.lore: It hums, as if it remembers being somewhere else.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.relic_kept: %s slips into your Pocket Stash. It's yours now.
